title: Delegation of powers
description: Delegation of administrative powers by Chief Commissioner

content.general_rule: The Chief Commissioner has powers of general superintendence, direction and control in respect of all administrative matters of the Central Authority
content.exception: The Chief Commissioner may delegate such powers to any Commissioner or any other officer of the Central Authority
